sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <desc id="desc">Animated SVG: a giant anteater with a long snout and bushy tail pedals a red unicycle and juggles three glass bottles against a moving circus landscape.</desc>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#6EC6F5"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#BDEBFF"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFF3C4"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#F7D98B"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#E8B95A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#D9BC8A"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#A9825A"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tailGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#C9A86F"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7A5A38"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="sunGrad"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#FFF7A8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#FFD93B"/></radialGradient>

    <!-- Bottle symbol, centred at 0,0 -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <path d="M-16,-28 L-16,-8 Q-16,-2 -12,2 L-12,30 Q-12,36 -6,36 L6,36 Q12,36 12,30 L12,2 Q16,-2 16,-8 L16,-28 Z" fill="inherit" stroke="#21403A" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="-7" y="-38" width="14" height="12" rx="3" fill="#D94F3D" stroke="#21403A" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="-8" y="4" width="5" height="26" rx="2.5" fill="white" opacity=".45"/>
      <rect x="-13" y="12" width="26" height="14" rx="2" fill="white" opacity=".82"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="19" r="4" fill="#21403A" opacity=".75"/>
    </g>

    <g id="tree">
      <rect x="-7" y="0" width="14" height="62" rx="6" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="-28" r="42" fill="#3FA34D"/>
      <circle cx="-32" cy="-8" r="30" fill="#57B96A"/>
      <circle cx="32" cy="-8" r="30" fill="#2E8B3A"/>
      <circle cx="-12" cy="-34" r="6" fill="#FF6B6B"/><circle cx="16" cy="-20" r="5" fill="#FFD93B"/>
    </g>

    <g id="cloud">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="62" ry="28" fill="white"/>
      <ellipse cx="-38" cy="8" rx="42" ry="20" fill="white"/>
      <ellipse cx="42" cy="8" rx="46" ry="22" fill="white"/>
      <ellipse cx="4" cy="-20" rx="38" ry="22" fill="white"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .wheel-spin{animation:spin 1.05s linear infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:600px 540px}
    .crank-spin{animation:spin 1.05s linear infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:600px 540px}
    .bob{animation:bob .525s ease-in-out infinite}
    .tail{animation:tail 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:510px 405px}
    .head{animation:headbob 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:715px 275px}
    .leg-near{animation:pedal 1.05s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:622px 438px}
    .leg-far{animation:pedal 1.05s ease-in-out infinite reverse;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:585px 438px}
    .paw-l{animation:pawl 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:625px 215px}
    .paw-r{animation:pawr 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:745px 215px}
    .blink{animation:blink 4s infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
    .tongue{animation:tongue 1.4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:848px 302px}
    .ear{animation:ear 2.1s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:702px 218px}
    .sun-rays{animation:spin 24s linear infinite;transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:150px 125px}
    .shadow{animation:shadow .525s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
    .sparkle{animation:sparkle 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
    .cloud1{animation:drift 26s linear infinite}
    .cloud2{animation:drift 38s linear infinite;animation-delay:-18s}
    .cloud3{animation:drift 31s linear infinite;animation-delay:-9s}
    @keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
    @keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px)}}
    @keyframes tail{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-7deg)}50%{transform:rotate(10deg)}}
    @keyframes headbob{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-2deg) translateY(0)}50%{transform:rotate(2deg) translateY(-4px)}}
    @keyframes pedal{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-28deg)}50%{transform:rotate(28deg)}}
    @keyframes pawl{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-4deg)}50%{transform:translateY(12px) rotate(5deg)}}
    @keyframes pawr{0%,100%{transform:translateY(12px) rotate(5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-4deg)}}
    @keyframes blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}95%{transform:scaleY(.08)}}
    @keyframes tongue{0%,55%,100%{transform:scaleX(.25) rotate(0deg)}70%,85%{transform:scaleX(1) rotate(3deg)}}
    @keyframes ear{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}50%{transform:rotate(-12deg)}}
    @keyframes shadow{0%,100%{transform:scaleX(1);opacity:.28}50%{transform:scaleX(.84);opacity:.18}}
    @keyframes sparkle{0%,100%{transform:scale(.5) rotate(0deg);opacity:.2}50%{transform:scale(1.25) rotate(45deg);opacity:1}}
    @keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(1350px)}to{transform:translateX(-250px)}}
  </style>

  <!-- SKY / SUN -->
  <rect width="1200" height="800" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <g class="sun-rays" stroke="#FFD93B" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".85">
    <line x1="150" y1="28" x2="150" y2="58"/><line x1="150" y1="192" x2="150" y2="222"/>
    <line x1="53" y1="125" x2="83" y2="125"/><line x1="217" y1="125" x2="247" y2="125"/>
    <line x1="82" y1="57" x2="103" y2="78"/><line x1="197" y1="172" x2="218" y2="193"/>
    <line x1="218" y1="57" x2="197" y2="78"/><line x1="103" y1="172" x2="82" y2="193"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="150" cy="125" r="62" fill="url(#sunGrad)" stroke="#F5B301" stroke-width="5"/>
  <g opacity=".95"><use href="#cloud" class="cloud1" y="95"/><use href="#cloud" class="cloud2" y="175" transform="scale(.7)"/><use href="#cloud" class="cloud3" y="60" transform="scale(.85)"/></g>

  <!-- DISTANT HILLS (slow scroll) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="-1200 0" dur="14s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="#8ED081">
      <path d="M-100,620 Q180,430 460,620 Z"/><path d="M350,620 Q650,440 950,620 Z"/><path d="M800,620 Q1100,450 1400,620 Z"/>
      <path d="M1100,620 Q1400,430 1700,620 Z"/><path d="M1550,620 Q1850,440 2150,620 Z"/><path d="M2000,620 Q2300,450 2600,620 Z"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- TREES (medium scroll, duplicated for loop) -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="-1200 0" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g transform="translate(0,0)">
      <use href="#tree" x="120" y="575"/><use href="#tree" x="430" y="590" transform="scale(.8) translate(100,140)"/>
      <use href="#tree" x="760" y="570"/><use href="#tree" x="1030" y="592" transform="scale(.75) translate(340,190)"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(1200,0)">
      <use href="#tree" x="120" y="575"/><use href="#tree" x="430" y="590" transform="scale(.8) translate(100,140)"/>
      <use href="#tree" x="760" y="570"/><use href="#tree" x="1030" y="592" transform="scale(.75) translate(340,190)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- GROUND / ROAD -->
  <rect y="615" width="1200" height="185" fill="url(#ground)"/>
  <rect y="615" width="1200" height="16" fill="#C68B3A"/>
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" from="0 0" to="-240 0" dur=".55s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <g fill="#FFF8D6">
      <rect x="20" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="260" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="500" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/>
      <rect x="740" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="980" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/><rect x="1220" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/>
      <rect x="1460" y="688" width="130" height="14" rx="7"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g fill="#D9A447" opacity=".7"><circle cx="180" cy="650" r="6"/><circle cx="540" cy="740" r="8"/><circle cx="920" cy="655" r="5"/><circle cx="1120" cy="750" r="7"/></g>

  <!-- Speed lines -->
  <g stroke="white" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".75">
